Nora Li: Quick docs bug: POST /v1/embeddings API ref shows inconsistent request examples. The cURL uses `input` (single string) while the Python example uses `inputs` (array). Our runtime accepts `input` as either a string or an array, but that ambiguity confuses users and the generated OpenAPI examples.

Ben Ortiz: Ugh. Which example files? can you paste both?

Nora Li: Curl example (current):
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-base","input":"hello world"}'
```
Python example (current):
```py
client.embeddings.create(model='embed-base', inputs=['hello','world'])
```
This mismatch leads to confusion: some people assume the API only accepts `inputs` array.

Yvonne Kim: We should standardize examples to show both accepted forms and recommend `inputs` (plural) for batch requests to be explicit. Also update the param docs: `input` can be string or array; prefer `inputs` for batching.

Ben Ortiz: Agreed. I will open a docs PR to: 1) make cURL example show array form (`input": ["hello","world"]`) 2) update Python/JS snippets to use `inputs` named param for clarity 3) add parameter note: "input: string | string[] (prefer `inputs` for batches)" 4) add a short migration note for older integrations that posted `text` instead of `input`.

Nora Li: Nice. Also add a one-line test in docs CI to validate the curl JSON body shape against the OpenAPI example for embeddings so further drift is prevented.

docs-bot: PR created by ben-ortiz: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1502 - title: "docs(embeds): standardize input vs inputs examples and add note"

Ben Ortiz: PR updated per copy. I switched curl to `input: ["hello","world"]` and Python/JS to `inputs=`. Left an explicit example showing single-string usage too: `input: "single string"`. Ran staging curl, returned 200.

ci-bot: docs CI: example-schema-check passed for /v1/embeddings examples

Yvonne Kim: LGTM. Merging after a quick smoke test on staging. Thanks!

Nora Li: Thanks everyone. Filed ENG follow-up to add a small warning header in the API response when `text` (old param) is received, to help callers migrate (ENG-1210). Closing thread. :sparkles:
